تفترشون (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِشُونَ (taftarišūna) /taf.ta.ri.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
# تُفْتَرَشُونَ (tuftarašūna) /tuf.ta.ra.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَشَ (iftaraša)
